newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil extends gains at close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil extends gains at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jul (3rd pos) 1,275 rgt/tonne Apr (south) 1,345 *
Open/hi/low 1,266/1,276/1,264 Prev close 1,330
Prev settlement 1,262 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices extended gains on speculative buying, helped by tightness in physical market, firmer Chicago soyoil futures and good export data for April 1-20. Immediate resistance for July futures is at 1,280 ringgit but the contract is seen heading for 1,300.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Remained firm on further covering by refiners due to tightness in crude palm oil supply.
"Exports should be around 600,000 tonnes this month and this will be good for the market," another trader said. Exports in March stood at 565,219 tonnes.
Traders said private crop forecaster Ivan Wong's projection of a six percent rise in April output to 723,000 tonnes was lower than some market estimates and also helped prices.

News that China is planning to buy 10,000 tonnes of palm oil from Thailand came too late to have any impact on the market on Monday. But traders said they did not see the news having any influence on market sentiment.
"What is 10,000 tonnes compared with 1.2-1.4 million tonnes of palm oil China buys annually," said a trader.
Third position July crude palm oil futures closed up 13 ringgit at 1,275 ringgit ($508.78) a tonne.
The contract is seen heading for 1,300 ringgit though some immediate resistance is expected at 1,280, traders said.
Volume on the futures market stood at 2,220 lots against 1,396 lots on Thursday. The market was closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha holiday.
Physicals prices remained firm on the back of refiners' covering.
April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,345 ringgit ($536.71) a tonne with bids at 1,340, after trading from 1,330 to 1,340.
April (central) was offered at 1,317.50 with bids at 1,312.50, and traded at 1,310 and 1,312.50.
April (north) saw offers at 1,300 and bids at 1,295.
May (south) was offered at 1,345 ringgit with bids at 1,340. It was traded from 1,325 to 1,340.
May (central) saw offers at 1,312.50 and bids at 1,307.50.

Among refined products, May RBD palm olein was offered at $600 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Jun at $587.50 and Jul/Aug/Sep at $575. May was traded at $592.50, Jun from $582.50 to $587.50, and Jul at $575 and $577.50.
May RBD palm oil was offered at $557.50, Jun at $552.50 and Jul/Aug/Sep at $545.
May RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $440 and Jun at $437.50.
May palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $290.
